letters.tail: That’s enough research agenda for several lifetimes, of course. But I articulate all this here as a way of helping myself resist the cultural forces surrounding me in San Francisco. Those forces demand that if I find an idea—like highlight-driven memory prompts—I should focus aggressively on scaling it to apply to as many places and people as possible. There’s merit in that, of course! I certainly want to use this special highlighter everywhere.

Too often, I’m captivated by a discussion of an idea, but when the associated prompts arise in my memory system, I’m left cold.
